uuid.description: Unique key for the equipment PM template object

companyEquipmentPmTemplateId.description: Ivo Systems identifier for the equipment PM template object.

pmTypeId.description: Type of PM template (1 = Hr Interval, 2 = Od Interval, 3 = Date Interval, 4 = Fixed Hr, 5 = Fixed Od, 6 = Fixed Date)

pmName.description: Identifying name for the PM template

intervalHours.description: Number of hours until PM is due on equipment (i.e. if interval is every 500 hours, this would be 500)

intervalDays.description: Number of days until PM is due on equipment (i.e. if interval is every 90 days, this would be 90)

intervalOdometer.description: Number of miles until PM is due on equipment (i.e. if interval is every 5000 miles, this would be 5000)

fixedDate.description: Fixed date to flag when PM is due on equipment

fixedHours.description: Fixed one time hours to flag when PM is due on equipment

fixedOdometer.description: Fixed one time mileage to flag when PM is due on equipment

partsNote.description: Parts required to complete the PM work

workNote.description: Work to be completed for pm template

triggerDays.description: Set number of days to alert you at prior to PM being due

triggerHours.description: Set number of hours to alert you at prior to PM being due

triggerOdometer.description: Set number of miles to alert you at prior to PM being due

applyChangesToChildren.description: Apply changes to pm templates assigned to equipment when this pm template is updated
